lastCompletedStory.title: Make /cam-ship Step 4b git rm robust to missing paths

nextStoryContext: US-001 landed: both cam-ship.md copies and the embedded vendor now use `git rm -q --ignore-unmatch` (dropping the 2>/dev/null || true mask). US-002 adds a regression test against the embedded artifact in src/vendor/_generated.ts. The export shape is `templatesContents: Readonly<Record<string, string>>` keyed by relative path like `commands/cam-ship.md`. The test should live at test/vendor/cam-ship-hygiene.test.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: `--ignore-unmatch` exits 0 when no files match; real errors (non-pathspec issues) still propagate non-zero. Implementation matches docs exactly.
